email.subject: Quick fix for Core Fitness's site
email.body:
Dev,

Looked at Core Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call on mobile, so anyone searching on their phone can't tap to reach you and probably just calls the next gym. And there are no reviews showing, which makes people checking out a new gym hesitate before signing up.

Also noticed heavy images slowing load time and a footer with an old year on it.

I fix these for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's costing you calls and sign-ups - no pitch, just the issues and fixes.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
